changes.geometry: B1 broadleaf/pine source-preserving lower-trunk fit and reattached crowns; source Y normalization, root burial and native bodies retained.
changes.line_endings: g1/art.gd retains the original mixed line endings (28 CRLF lines); the selection hook adds LF lines. New UTF-8 R1 source/evidence files retain their recorded LF/CRLF bytes, all covered by per-file hashes.

static_verification.scope: Exact worker ancestry, exclusive Git paths, source/sealed recipe agreement, Python parsing, whitespace and all retained runner-log hashes. Full input/package payload verification is executed separately before fresh application.

fresh_verification.scope: Fresh publisher cache/state and separate-process native checks. Verification runs are not repeated benchmark or long-session claims.

visual_review: Publisher inspected actual Forward+ broadleaf/pine pairs and player-height home day/shade/dusk views. Crowns visibly spread while existing thin foliage, blunt limbs, strong lower flare and dark shade remain. Owner visual acceptance is pending.
finding: G2-V01: partial; isolated canopy fit is technically verified, with visual acceptance and combined R8/R9 review pending.
remaining_limits: Preserve worker-reported warning history, sparse LOD2 leaves, dark shade and renderer response. The worker reports higher GPU cost from wider foliage; current-machine timings and projected crown AABBs establish neither minimum-hardware acceptance nor opaque leaf coverage. R8 must merge G1Art.resource with R2 reuse and R7 habitat presentation. The publisher did not repeat the full paid-route benchmark suite.
worker_remaining_limits: Owner visual acceptance remains pending. Broadleaf has inherited blunt/heavy limbs, pronounced trunk flare and sparse LOD2 foliage; shade is dark and renderer responses differ.
Crown overlap is projected imported upper-mesh AABB overlap, not opaque leaf coverage or a complete tree census. Actual matched images accompany the measurements.

Raw paid/final snapshots differ only in one generated forge scene name (@StaticBody3D@4310 / @StaticBody3D@4311); every other saved field, native station key, ownership and geography match. No original native assertion or save code changed.
Current Ryzen 9 9950X3D / RTX 5090 timings are not minimum-hardware acceptance. Single-run streaming worst frames remain about 0.75 s; R2 owns loading policy.
Blender sampler warnings, B1/C4 ObjectDB exit warnings and Compatibility SSAO warnings remain visible. Material binding/sampler audit passes all 19 exports; R4 owns lifecycle cleanup.
Rejected v01/v02 geometry, unused-mask and parse failures, and first non-finite camera captures are retained as diagnostic history. Four earlier exit-zero captures are not accepted visual evidence.
Scar nearest-surface measurements across independently decimated siblings do not establish exact signed incision depth. Altered emission-off/on actual model views are supplied.
Ordinary-world rollout, rig adoption, new scatter/body/shape/recipe, ground-cover composition and cache changes are outside R1. No missing body/seat/geography decision was invented.
publication: These notes accompany an ordinary non-force push to approved origin/main. Actual remote-tip verification is retained separately after that push.
runtime_adoption: Publication makes the isolated candidate available. R8 composes runtime hooks; ordinary-world rollout is not included.
